business_problem: Auchan needed to replace costly, less scalable relational repositories and consolidate critical retail data into a more responsive platform.
solution_summary: Auchan Retail International migrated key information repositories and operational retail data onto MongoDB Atlas after its relational environment became too expensive and difficult to scale for a business operating in 12 countries. Atlas now stores prices, products, receipts, site, supplier, and naming-convention data that previously sat across multiple repositories, with APIs and indexes ensuring the information stays accessible across the retailer's operations. MongoDB and partner ADVANCED Schema supported the proof of concept, migration planning, and agile squad execution, while MongoDB App Services CLI and the wider Atlas ecosystem added flexibility on top of the core database. The program met its timeline, produced full ROI by mid-2024, and gave users real-time execution and faster access to repositories in eight countries.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores consolidated operational repositories for prices, products, receipts, sites, suppliers, and naming conventions.

solution_components.name: MongoDB App Services CLI
solution_components.role: Adds integrated application-service flexibility on top of the Atlas deployment.

data_flow: Operational repository data for prices, products, receipts, sites, suppliers, and naming conventions is consolidated in MongoDB Atlas, indexed and exposed via APIs, and served across eight-country operations with real-time reporting.
business_outcome: Auchan hit its migration schedule, achieved full ROI by mid-2024, cut hosting costs, and gave users faster real-time access to critical repositories.
metrics: Auchan generates €32.3 billion in yearly revenue, with nearly 154,000 employees and 2,354 points of sale.
The company was paying €1.2 million a year for hosting.

Data was indexed and made accessible via APIs across the new organization system.
